value.behaviour: Adds the dev dependencies the new CardExtension test needs.

sites.rule: Add four devDependencies in this order: "@backstage/test-utils": "workspace:^", "@testing-library/dom": "^10.0.0", "@testing-library/jest-dom": "^6.0.0", "@testing-library/react": "^16.0.0".

value.behaviour: Adds @backstage/plugin-home-react as a dependency of the notifications plugin.
Installs so yarn.lock records the new workspace dependencies and node_modules matches them.
Splits CardExtension into a custom Renderer path that needs no app context and an unchanged default path.
rules: CardExtension keeps its name, generic and props type; it stays a thin dispatcher with no hooks, so no hook runs conditionally.
The custom Renderer path calls neither useApp nor useTranslationRef and passes Renderer the same props as today.
The default path keeps the same InfoCard, settings modal, actions, ContextProvider handling and the app's Progress as Suspense fallback.

sites.rule: Replace with a non-exported CardExtensionWithCustomRenderer<T>, whose props are CardExtensionComponentProps<T> & { Renderer: NonNullable<ComponentRenderer['Renderer']> } and which holds the old destructuring and the old Renderer block inside <Suspense fallback={<CircularProgress />}>, followed by the header of a non-exported DefaultCardExtension<T>(props: CardExtensionComponentProps<T>) with the old destructuring minus Renderer and the lines from useApp through useTranslationRef. The following const cardProps stays as the rest of DefaultCardExtension.

Add a blank line, then export function CardExtension<T>(props: CardExtensionComponentProps<T>) that returns <CardExtensionWithCustomRenderer {...props} Renderer={props.Renderer} /> when props.Renderer is set, else <DefaultCardExtension {...props} />.

value.behaviour: Loads the jest-dom matchers for plugins/home-react tests.
rules: The file is the licence header followed by import '@testing-library/jest-dom';

value.behaviour: Shows CardExtension rendering with a custom Renderer and no app context, and the default path unchanged.
rules: Import CardExtension and type RendererProps from './extensions', render and screen from @testing-library/react, renderInTestApp from @backstage/test-utils.
The custom Renderer case uses plain render, with no renderInTestApp or provider around it.

The fallback case passes the option components: { Progress: () =>
App progress
} to renderInTestApp and a Content made with React lazy over a promise that never resolves, cast to the Content type.

uses.reason: RendererProps and the component part types the test builds on.

tests.name: renders a custom Renderer without app context
tests.given: CardExtension with title, a Renderer that shows title and Content, and a Content, rendered with plain render
tests.expect: The render does not throw and the heading and the content are in the document

tests.name: renders the default card with its title, content, actions and context provider
tests.given: CardExtension with no Renderer, with title, Content, Actions and a ContextProvider that wraps children in a labelled element, in renderInTestApp
tests.expect: The title, the content and the actions show, inside the element the ContextProvider adds

tests.name: opens the settings modal from the default card
tests.given: CardExtension with no Renderer and a Settings part, in renderInTestApp
tests.expect: Pressing the settings icon button shows the Settings content

tests.name: uses the app Progress as the fallback on the default path
